    Lemma A.7: closed paths of degree sixteen in Π(E₇) #

    lem:e7-sixteen-return: "Every vertex of Π(E₇) has a nonzero closed path of path degree sixteen, over every field. … Thus U_0, …, U_8 are nonnegative. The same recurrence gives U_9 = U_7. Its reversibility implies U_{8+j} = U_{8-j} for 0 ≤ j ≤ 8. In particular U_16 = I and all preceding matrices are nonnegative. Apply (A.17)."

    The matrices U_d are integer matrices determined by the recurrence; we list them in a fixed labelling of the vertices and check the recurrence, the nonnegativity and U_16 = I by direct computation.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
